newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps upgrades Cincinnati Bell.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps upgrades Cincinnati Bell.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Thursday it upgraded Cincinnati Bell Inc's note rating to Single A from Single A Minus.
It also raised the company's commercial paper rating to D One from D One Minus and reaffirmed Cincinnati Bell Telephone's note and debenture ratings of Double A Minus.

Duff & Phelps placed Cincinnati Bell Inc and Cincinnati Bell Telephone on rating watch for a possible upgrade following the announcement of plans by the company to restructure its debt and terminate a costly interest rate and currency swap arrangement.
